method: Strict saturated red/blue ink per native column; min/max selected ink; omit absent columns; no interpolation. Derived midpoint is not simulation centerline.
reading_uncertainty: Conservative +/-2 native pixels: Te +/-10.82 eV, Ti +/-8.66 eV, time +/-0.01247 ns. Not calibrated confidence interval. Sharp rises amplify horizontal uncertainty.
limitations: No distinct center curve reliably identified; colored outlines bound spatial-inhomogeneity shading.
Envelopes include stroke thickness and may miss edges obscured by experimental markers; both_physical_bounds_certified=false for every row.
Shading is plasma inhomogeneity, not measurement statistical error.
Experimental square values inferred by spectral fitting are not simulation truth.
Common Ti does not give separate H/C temperature truth.
No quantitative flow reference; text only says central flow and Doppler shift are small.

geometry.density_caveat: Fill baseline only, not per-time local density
